column5: Prints `Madaros v0.80.0 -- the Sounio self-hosted compiler`. README Get started says the same command prints `souc 1.0.0-beta.6`.
Names wrapper, raw ELF, stdlib, identity.
Prints madaros usage, not souc verbs. A stranger who typed `souc` is told to run `madaros check`. `souc --help` is the souc surface; bare invocation is not.
`error: madaros check requires <source.sio> or a project with sounio.toml` — the path ended in .sio and was absent. Message does not say the file does not exist.
`check: OK`. Guide §1 exact. Also OK with SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH unset.
`module failed to parse`. First failing construct is `.ε` field access (isolated: Knowledge[f64] + ε= constructor checks; `let conf = x.ε` parse-fails). No line, no token, no `.epsilon` hint.
Guide says no semicolons. `let x = 5;` check: OK and `souc run` prints hi.
Get-started path. We wrote this file; not a stranger program.
